[[File:BroonTers2-CSWE.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Broon Ters's pazaak game with Doton Het]]
'''Broon Ters''' was an individual who was a contemporary of [[Doton Het]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who was active during the<ref name="kotor2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> [[Dark Wars]] between [[3955 BBY]] and [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="kotorcg">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> a series of conflicts between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Triumvirate|remnants]] of [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire]].<ref name="kotor2" /> On one occasion, Ters played a [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] card game called [[Pazaak/Legends|pazaak]] against Het.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|15|Pazaak}}</ref> At one point during the pazaak match, both Ters and Het had won two rounds of play each. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], Ters had two cards left to use and Het had three cards remaining.<ref name="TCSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:PazaakBroonTersDotonHet-KotOR2.jpg|thumb|right|150px|The original image]]
The name Broon Ters originated as a player-chosen name used for the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] in [[Obsidian Entertainment]]'s [[2004]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''.<ref name="kotor2" /> In order to provide an illustration of a game of pazaak, a {{Srlink|File:PazaakBroonTersDotonHet-KotOR2.jpg|screenshot}} of the game was uploaded to the online ''[[Star Wars]]'' encyclopedia [[Wookieepedia]] by the user {{Srlink|User:Kaal-Jhyy|Kaal-Jhyy}}.<ref name="Wookieepedia">{{WookCite|url=File:Pazaak(KOTOR2).jpg?oldid=435372|text=File:PazaakBroonTersDotonHet-KotOR2.jpg}}</ref>

This screenshot was later printed in [[Del Rey]]'s [[2008]] ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', with the removal of an action box declaring that Ters won the fourth round of play. While the name "Broon Ters" was made [[canon]]ical,<ref name="TCSWE" /> ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]'', a novel by [[Drew Karpyshyn]] released in [[2011]], named the Exile "Meetra Surik."<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> Therefore, Broon Ters must have been a separate character.<ref name="kotor2" />
